obligations.name: qualifying_workspaces
obligations.description: Workspaces that contain a channel holding a message which received a rocket-emoji reaction from a user whose workspace-membership role is admin in that same workspace.
obligations.scope: workspaces reachable via channel->message->reaction->user->workspace-membership chain matching the admin/rocket condition

task_spec.text: Identify and list every workspace that has a channel with a message reacted to by a rocket emoji from an admin of that same workspace.

access_plan: Discover workspaces via teams; for each, use conversations.list (team_id scoped) to enumerate its channels, conversations.history to pull messages in each channel, and reactions.get per message to see reactor and emoji name. For each rocket reactor, check their workspace-membership role (via users.info / team membership data) restricted to the same team_id as the channel being examined, and only count the workspace if that specific membership role is admin. Aggregate the team_ids that satisfy this into the final list.
